notes.title: v3.11 + Achievements/Trading Cards
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! Thank you all for the wonderful support and patience you have shown Erkerut as he builds the next Chapter of Wet Nightmares. We have a small update for you all today.[/p][p][/p][h3]Script and Narrative[/h3][p]General bugs and fixes for the script and systems have been implemented into the game. Many of these were identified by the dedicated community and fans, so thank you all very much for your feedback! [/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Community Content[/h3][p]We have worked with Steam support to bring the Steam customers two exciting features: Steam Achievements and Steam Trading Cards! The achievements right now are a simple track of the chapters you’ve progressed through, but as alternative paths and endings are created, expect a few more hidden ones to appear. And the trading cards come with some emoticons and backgrounds for you all to collect and trade![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/cd124d83d6d2a06995276ac47785ce1fca316156.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Chapter 03 News[/h3][p]For those of you looking to get an update on how things are going, we have finished up the Chapter 03 overhaul text, and it is now getting an English Copy pass. Erkerut is hard at work blocking out the chapter before it goes into the engine. This is the process of creating “dummy” art to fill in the space where new pieces are needed. It allows us to see the flow and process of it all, and it helps make sure the game has all the art planned it needs. [/p][p]I can also throw in here some of the sketches used for the dummy images in the blocking, without any sort of context to give you all an idea of how it's looking. The current goal is to put everything in the game and get a build ready to put out as a beta.[/p][p]Spoilers ahead, I guess![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/b3f2ae5d39a00b50c03ea2de220e3cc017a8b675.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/e28ffdd9e584fe2cc508f636e3b3103bae98a547.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/94f22fb8868a8b1e5aae8ac718f722862e109e3a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/def601d75a10ee688ab169c2443f096b17209e64.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/592d74e5147ba7bc1d9f56a68eef9ce1360e3845.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/5388a861ff033365f1625223c76462257e925527.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/ce8f0a2b2bdc86c89167f8aef59ed21642758336.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/3ba9eef4601da78be340abd3da1d94e5efbf3d52.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/a178a1aa36983bf6a67b078489918704d2f99b70.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/a412913584b7e3f88b87e7d6a181ae97eef273a1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/fb1a822e480446ac428eec3b90b586f2c6597d1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, Erkerut wanted me to pass on his thanks for your patience. notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
It’s cold out there, the warmth of a lone cabin draws you in. The wood beneath your feet groans under your weight. Collect yourself, and knock.

Wet Nightmares is out right now in the Early Access program! Developing this game has been a right of passage for everyone involved. It started as a solo project for Erkerut, and with the involvement of Kinky Fridays, the game has come leaps and bounds since then. Today we are proud to offer the game to you all, after all this time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/ebddf63ce7ebdb42a20a97948039b4e50b122d9b.png[/img]

The launch of Wet Nightmares starts with the first two chapters of the game and two languages (English and Spanish). The full narrative has already been written, and development will be done Chapter by Chapter. Meaning after we launch today pre-production and planning begin for Chapter 3.

The full project will be 5 total Chapters with several endings, and polish is at the core of what makes Wet Nightmares work. Check out the roadmap below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/9c7a49b15eeadd4f7cec8fb2286f12a1f4218976.jpg[/img]

We hope you all enjoy what we’ve put together and please do jump into the forums and give feedback on everything you’ve experienced with our game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555910/Wet_Nightmares/

I am looking forward to hearing from you all!

notes.title: Dev Pages #05
notes.notes:
​Hello everyone! Thank you very much for your patience in waiting for news about Wet Nightmares and our development. There is always a big question floating around as to when the next patch will come so let me quickly put everyone’s hearts to rest.

Wet Nightmares Chapter 01 is now in a Gold state, meaning that the first chapter has been fully completed, and all the polish and shine needed to make the chapter amazing has been added. The release for this will be coming in the next couple of weeks or so.

So why not release it right now? Good question! We are polishing up the other things around the game right now, these include overhauls to the Main Menu, Save/Load Screens, CG Gallery, Backlogs, Navigation UI, Options Menu, adding QOL Features to save prompts and exit notifications, Optimizing the game file structure, and generally improving player expectations on the product as a whole. The reason for this is that following the menu overhaul we will be updating our Demo for the final time (since it is based on Chapter 01) and this will be released alongside the new content patch for Chapter 01.

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/0a73697c96598da63a8bc9ae844598834801bdf9.png[/img]

Okay, that is great, what about why you never post news anymore? The simple reason is that the only content worth sharing is entirely spoiler-related, meaning anything we share you won't be experiencing in the game for the first time. A very annoying catch-22, but here we are.

What about Chapter 02? When is that coming? Well, we are about 75% done, meaning the basics are in place it just needs a spitshine on the content. To give you an idea of what that means, basically, I sit down with the team and play the game line by line, then break down what I need to be changed to keep things consistent. This means making sure things like “Two scenes ago this light was off, and now it is on, so we need the background to change” or “Samara already took her panties off, so she should be naked here, do we need to change when she takes her panties off?”. It also means finding little issues with when audio cues play, or how the scenes animate. Then the changes get implemented, and we do the playthrough again, and again, and again, and again. Until all the edges and issues are removed, leading to a very polished experience. That's what's left to do in Chapter 02.

Lastly, in the next coming days, expect to see the store page for Wet Nightmares get a nice overhaul as well, we are going to be replacing all the screenshots, marketing materials, and key art around the game with new stuff. Content that better emphasizes the focus of the narrative and presents the game in a more focused light.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555910/Wet_Nightmares/

Stay tuned for a new drop!

notes.title: Dev Pages #02
notes.notes:
Hello readers! Welcome to another update post for Wet Nightmares! Work is continuing at a good pace, and we hope to have a lot more than just a simple update to share with you all in the near future, but here is what we have for today.

[h2]Narrative Overview[/h2]
As most of you know Wet Nightmares is not written in English by default, Spanish is actually the first language of the game. So a lot of care needs to go into the translation to make our largest audience feel at home and cover the sense of scarousal we are aiming to achieve.

Chapters 1 and 2 for the English copy and translation are all but done. We are adding a few “extra” chapters between each main chapter to bring even more horror elements to the game. So that there will mean our writing team will be back at work and the process will take a little longer.

[h2]Art Overview[/h2]
Erk is smashing his way through the reworking of all the major art components in Wet Nightmares, these include redrawing existing scenes (just because he is better at his craft than he used to be).

notes.title: Engine Overhaul v0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]This is a copy of our v0.2 release post for early adopters over on Itch.[/h1]

Come on in from the cold, and warm yourself with a cup of coffee. Wet Nightmares is ready, and another patch is good to play. However this update is quite different, there is zero new content. Stay with me here, let me explain.

Wet Nightmares has been completely remade on a new engine. Meaning every single issue plaguing the game has been erased, all the compatibility issues with android phones, end user pc configurations, and all the nagging little bugs are no longer here. We’ve also reduced the game size by about 700mb down to a very cool 500mb in size.

As we built the game more and more we began to run into game-breaking issues, what should be a very lightweight game ended up having issues on just about all platforms. Our primary goal in moving from Visual Novel Maker over to Renpy was fixing our stability issues. The game now runs buttery smooth, especially on Android phones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923268/2f76f672f441471a7921dda01931b9ccfd29c3a4.gif[/img]

It has taken us several months to complete this task, a massive thanks to our programmer who has been working hard to get it perfect. As thanks for your patience, owners will also have access to a Samara Pinup Pack, 17 very lewd Samara drawings to help with those cold nights.

[h2]What’s next for Wet Nightmares?[/h2]
The future for this little story is a bright one! With the newly ported source code to Renpy we can finally focus on chapter 2 and beyond. The story has been completely written in Spanish, and first-pass English. Our next steps are the copy work for English and to “block out” chapter 2 and more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555910/Wet_Nightmares/

Thank you all very much for being patient while we work out the kinks in the bones of Wet Nightmares. We hope you all enjoy the new build.

notes.title: Elewder coming to Early Acecss
notes.notes:
It is our pleasure to announce that our latest game Elewder, the hotly anticipated erotic twin-stick shooter roguelike, will be coming to Steam’s Early Access on October 27th! 

We have been working hard all year on this game, and have finally advanced the development to the beta state, from here on out we will be looking to balance our combat and progression mechanics, incorporate community feedback and suggestions, polish our presentation and visuals, and implement our narrative. The Early Access platform provides the perfect space to do just that.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36878805/7c8354a824583d8f1c58eb2e0681720ebd85b4a6.png[/img]

The upcoming beta release means that all of our desired gameplay mechanics and loops are implemented within the game itself, some like the core gameplay loop are more fleshed out than others, but the bones that make up the whole game are in place and ready for more content.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36878805/8dfdb2a3024dd7e977282373b72d55f8ba258557.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]All 15 levels and the level progression are in the game.[/b] If can overcome the labyrinth, you can make it to the end of the game and face off against the Succubus herself.
[*] [b]All 5 unique biome and tilesets are read to explore.[/b] Each boss you encounter will have a unique staging area that will eventually change the enemies you face off against.
[*] [b]All 5 bosses are ready to be conquered.[/b] Face off against the mighty Succubus Queen and her four Generals.
[*] [b]A basic dialogue and narrative system.[/b] The narrative elements in Elewder will come with time, the basic system and dialogue overlays are in the game only as a placeholder for now.
[*] [b]A handful of items and spells to equip.[/b] While a far cry from the total items we plan to add, the items in the beta release will help inform you all on how combat will eventually end up.
[*] [b]Unique rooms to uncover.[/b] The total unique rooms to be found in Elewders maze is only numbering in the few, with more to come from our own plans and community feedback.
[*] [b]Basic implementation of our dynamic OST.[/b] The soundtrack for Elewder is being handcrafted right now, and our system for dynamically scaling the music is at its infancy.
[/list]

Here is what we will be adding during the Early Access development time:

[list]
[*] [b]Major balance and economy modifications.[/b] Our goal is to make each run of Elewder enjoyable, unique, and accessible while maintaining a skillful gameplay design.
[*] [b]Massive variety of enemies and encounters.[/b] The minions of the Succubus army should and will feel unique, each room you enter, every floor you conquer will lead to more varied and interesting combat scenarios.
[*] [b]Highly erotic and detailed animation sets.[/b] We want every single animation in Elewder to be dripping with lust and erotic energies. 
[*] [b]Narrative and Plot.[/b] The story of Elewder and the tutorials/interactions found within her walls will be a delight to many. A real focus will be placed on finding the right voice actors for each role and bringing them to life with amazing performances.
[*] [b]Gameplay modifications and earning your win.[/b] Right now only a handful of gameplay items and spells can be found in Elewder. We aim to increase the total number of items to around 100 and spells to roughly the same. No two runs will ever be the same.
[*] [b]Meta Gameplay and progression.[/b] Failure is not the end in Elewder, each run will reward the player a chance to grow their power outside the run, making the game that much more rewarding to play.
[*] [b]Rooms to explore.[/b] Each run will have a host of unique and powerful rooms and NPC’s to find and understand, some powerful, some not so much.
[*] [b]A uniquely composed soundtrack.[/b] Our team is hard at work composing a unique orchestra-metal-infused soundtrack for the game, the tracklisting right now is around 13 3-4 minute tracks that will blow your minds once you hear it.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597710/Elewder/

We hope you join us for this amazing development journey, Elewder is shaping up to be a fantastic experience, we cannot wait for you all to get your hands on it!
